query:
SELECT a.handle AS "handle!", d.slug, d.name,
    to_char(b.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS "updated_at!",
    encode(b.head_hash, 'hex') AS "head!",
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM thumbnail t WHERE t.revision_hash = b.head_hash AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM blocked_blob bb WHERE bb.hash IN (t.large_hash, t.small_hash)
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM revision r
        JOIN tree_entry te ON te.tree_hash = r.tree_hash
        JOIN blocked_blob bb ON bb.hash = te.blob_hash
        WHERE r.hash = t.revision_hash
    )
    ) AS "thumbnail!"
         FROM design d
         JOIN account a ON a.id = d.owner_id
         JOIN branch b ON b.design_id = d.id AND b.name = d.default_branch
         WHERE d.owner_id = $1 AND d.visibility = 'public'
         ORDER BY b.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC
